lessons.title: Rejalar: I'm going to / I'm gonna
lessons.goal: Kelasi zamondagi rejalarni aytishni o'rganasiz: going to va uning so'zlashuv shakli gonna.

frame.name: going to / gonna + fe'l
frame.formula:
I'm going to watch a film tonight.
She's going to sing at the concert.
We're gonna visit the exhibition.
Are you going to buy a ticket?
frame.explain: going to — oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat. So'zlashuvda u deyarli har doim gonna bo'lib aytiladi: I'm gonna watch. Yozuvda va rasmiy nutqda esa to'liq shakl ishlatiladi.
table: am / is / are going to + fe'l
reja — going to, hozirgi qaror — will

aff: I'm going to watch a film.
She's going to sing at the concert.
neg: I'm not going to watch a film.
She isn't going to sing at the concert.
q: Are you going to watch a film?
Is she going to sing at the concert?
short: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.

examples.en: I'm going to watch a new film tonight, and my sister is going to read a novel.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun yangi film ko'rmoqchiman, singlim esa roman o'qimoqchi.

examples.en: She's going to sing at the concert, and the whole band is going to play.
examples.uz: U kontsertda qo'shiq aytmoqchi, butun guruh esa chalmoqchi.

examples.en: We're gonna visit the art exhibition on Saturday — do you want to come?
examples.uz: Shanba kuni ko'rgazmaga bormoqchimiz — kelmoqchimisiz?

examples.en: Are you going to buy a ticket for the show?
examples.uz: Spektaklga chipta olmoqchimisiz?

examples.en: He isn't going to watch TV tonight; he's going to listen to the radio.
examples.uz: U bugun kechqurun televizor ko'rmoqchi emas; radio tinglamoqchi.

examples.en: The museum is going to open a new exhibition of sculpture and painting.
examples.uz: Muzey haykaltaroshlik va rassomlik bo'yicha yangi ko'rgazma ochmoqchi.

examples.en: I'm not going to read this magazine — the story is boring.
examples.uz: Bu jurnalni o'qimoqchi emasman — hikoya zerikarli.

examples.en: They're gonna take a lot of photos at the festival.
examples.uz: Festivalda ko'p surat olmoqchilar.

items.en: What are you gonna do tonight?

Modern painting and sculpture. And then a concert in the park.

lessons.title: Taqqoslash: bigger than, more expensive
lessons.goal: Ikki narsani taqqoslashni o'rganasiz: -er / more + than. Mamlakat va geografiya lug'ati.

frame.name: Comparative: -er / more + than
frame.formula:
Tashkent is bigger than Samarkand.
This road is longer than that one.
English is easier than Chinese.
This book is more interesting than that one.
frame.explain: Qisqa sifatlarga -er, uzun sifatlar oldiga more qo'shiladi va keyin than keladi. Noto'g'ri shakllar: good → better, bad → worse, far → further.

aff: This map is more useful than that one.
neg: This map isn't more useful than that one.
short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

examples.en: Russia is the biggest country in the world, and it's much larger than England.
examples.uz: Rossiya dunyodagi eng katta mamlakat va Angliyadan ancha katta.

examples.en: Great Britain is an island, so you can't travel there by train from Europe.
examples.uz: Buyuk Britaniya orol, shuning uchun Yevropadan u yerga poyezdda borib bo'lmaydi.

examples.en: Is it easier to travel abroad with a visa or without one?
examples.uz: Chet elga viza bilan borish osonroqmi yoki vizasizmi?

examples.en: My map is older than yours, but it's still useful.
examples.uz: Mening xaritam siznikidan eski, lekin hali ham foydali.

examples.en: The north of the country is colder than the south.
examples.uz: Mamlakat shimoli janubdan sovuqroq.

examples.en: Asia is bigger than Europe, and Africa is bigger than both.
examples.uz: Osiyo Yevropadan katta, Afrika esa ikkisidan ham katta.

examples.en: Foreign currency is more expensive at the airport than at the bank.
examples.uz: Chet el valyutasi aeroportda bankdagidan qimmatroq.

examples.en: Her nationality is British, but she lives abroad and works at the embassy.
examples.uz: Uning millati britan, lekin chet elda yashaydi va elchixonada ishlaydi.

street.title: Chet elga sayohat

items.en: Do I have to declare this?

street.note: abroad so'zi bilan artikl va predlog ishlatilmaydi: go abroad, live abroad — "in abroad" xato.

lines.en: Have you ever been abroad?
Yes, I travelled to England last year.
Was it difficult to get a visa?
Not really, but it was more expensive than I expected.
lines.uz: Unchalik emas, lekin kutganimdan qimmatroq bo'ldi.

lines.en: Is England bigger than Russia?
No, it's much smaller — but the distances inside London are longer than you think.
lines.uz: Yo'q, ancha kichik — lekin London ichidagi masofalar o'ylaganingizdan uzunroq.

substitution.answer: Tashkent is bigger than Samarkand.

substitution.prompt: This book is ___ than that one. (interesting)
substitution.answer: This book is more interesting than that one.
English is easier than Chinese.
My bag is better than yours.

substitution.prompt: The north is ___ than the south. (cold)
substitution.answer: The north is colder than the south.

translate.en: This book is more interesting than that one.

fix.wrong: Tashkent is more big than Samarkand.
He is more good than me.

lessons.tip: Qisqa sifat (1 bo'g'in) → -er: big → bigger, cold → colder. Uzun sifat (2+ bo'g'in) → more: more expensive. Istisno: good → better, bad → worse, far → further.

lessons.title: Eng: the biggest, the most expensive
lessons.goal: Orttirma darajani (the biggest / the most expensive) va ravishlarni (-ly) o'rganasiz.

frame.name: Superlative: the + -est / the most
frame.formula:
This is the biggest city in the country.
It's the most expensive restaurant.
She speaks the most clearly.
He runs faster than me.
frame.explain: Orttirma daraja: the + sifat + est yoki the most + sifat. Ravishlar ko'pincha -ly qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi: quiet → quietly, careful → carefully. Istisnolar: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard.
table: good → the best / bad → the worst

aff: This is the biggest city in the country.
neg: This isn't the biggest city in the country.
She doesn't speak the most clearly.
q: Is this the biggest city in the country?
short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

examples.en: Tashkent is the biggest city in Central Asia, and the metro is the fastest way to travel there.
examples.uz: Toshkent Markaziy Osiyodagi eng katta shahar va metro u yerda borishning eng tez usuli.

examples.en: She speaks quietly, but she explains everything very clearly.
examples.uz: U sekin gapiradi, lekin hamma narsani juda aniq tushuntiradi.

examples.en: This is the most expensive restaurant in the city, but the food is the best.
examples.uz: Bu shahardagi eng qimmat restoran, lekin ovqat eng yaxshisi.

examples.en: He drives carefully and never goes too fast.
examples.uz: U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi va hech qachon juda tez yurmaydi.

examples.en: They suddenly stopped and immediately called the police.
examples.uz: Ular birdan to'xtashdi va darhol politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.

examples.en: I almost forgot your birthday — I'm really sorry.
examples.uz: Tug'ilgan kuningizni deyarli unutdim — juda kechirasiz.

examples.en: Finally, we did the task together, and it wasn't hard at all.
examples.uz: Oxir-oqibat vazifani birga bajardik va bu umuman qiyin bo'lmadi.

examples.en: It's quite cold today, and it's probably going to rain.
examples.uz: Bugun ancha sovuq va yomg'ir yog'ishi ehtimol.

street.title: Baholash
street.note: "the best" — good ning orttirma darajasi; "well" uning ravishi: He is a good driver / He drives well.

lines.en: What's the fastest way to the airport?
By metro, probably. It's the cheapest too.
lines.uz: Metro bo'lsa kerak. Eng arzoni ham.

lines.en: Is it the most comfortable?
No, a taxi is more comfortable, but it's the most expensive.
lines.uz: Yo'q, taksi qulayroq, lekin eng qimmati.

lines.en: OK, let's go by metro. We need to leave immediately.
lines.uz: Mayli, metroda boramiz. Darhol chiqishimiz kerak.

lines.en: I'm almost ready. Just give me a minute.

substitution.answer: This is the biggest city in the country.

substitution.answer: She is the best student in the class.

He speaks quietly.
She drives carefully.

This is the most expensive restaurant.

fix.wrong: This is the most big city.

lessons.tip: Ravish va sifat farqi: quiet — sokin (sifat: a quiet room), quietly — sekin (ravish: he speaks quietly). "He speaks quiet" — xato.

lessons.title: Kelasi zamon va pul: I will / I'll pay
lessons.goal: will orqali kelasi zamon, va'da va qarorni bildirishni o'rganasiz. Pul va xarid lug'ati.

frame.name: will + fe'l
frame.formula:
I will help you.        → I'll help you.
She will call you tomorrow.
We won't be late.
Will you come?   — Yes, I will.
It costs five hundred thousand — I'll pay in cash.
frame.explain: will + o'zak fe'l — kelasi zamon, va'da va hozirgi qaror. Qisqargan shakli 'll, inkori won't. Barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: I will, she will, they will. Bu darsda katta sonlar va pul so'zlarini ham mustahkamlaymiz.

short: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
Yes, she will. / No, she won't.

examples.en: This phone costs four hundred thousand, and that one costs ninety.
examples.uz: Bu telefon to'rt yuz ming turadi, anavisi esa to'qson.

examples.en: I'll pay in cash, and I'll keep the receipt.
examples.uz: Naqd pulda to'layman va chekni saqlab qo'yaman.

examples.en: Will you pay by card or in cash?
examples.uz: Karta bilan to'laysizmi yoki naqd?

examples.en: There is a ten percent discount, so the price is lower than last year.
examples.uz: O'n foiz chegirma bor, shuning uchun narx o'tganga qaraganda past.

examples.en: It will cost fifty thousand, and you can pay by card.
examples.uz: Ellik ming turadi, karta bilan to'lasangiz bo'ladi.

examples.en: I need a loan from the bank; I don't want to get into debt.
examples.uz: Menga bankdan kredit kerak; qarzga botishni xohlamayman.

examples.en: If the product is broken, the customer can ask for a refund.
examples.uz: Agar mahsulot buzuq bo'lsa, mijoz pulini qaytarishni so'rashi mumkin.

examples.en: The company sold two million dollars of goods in sixty days.
examples.uz: Kompaniya oltmish kunda ikki million dollarlik mahsulot sotdi.

street.title: Pul haqida

items.en: How much is it all together?

street.note: "I'll take it" — xarid paytida "bunisini olaman" degan tabiiy ibora; "Keep the change" — qaytimni qoldirish.

lines.en: How much is it all together?
Three hundred thousand. Will you pay by card or in cash?
lines.uz: Uch yuz ming. Karta bilan to'laysizmi yoki naqd?

lines.en: By card. Is there a discount?
Yes, ten percent. And the price is the same all year.
lines.uz: Ha, o'n foiz. Va narx butun yil bir xil.

lines.en: Great. Can I have a receipt, please?
Of course. Here you are.

substitution.answer: I will help you.
She will call you tomorrow.
We won't be late.
Will you come?
I'll pay in cash.
This phone costs four hundred thousand.

lessons.tip: Katta sonlar uchga bo'linadi: 1,000,000 — one million. O'zbekchada "bir yarim million" bo'lsa, inglizchada one and a half million yoki 1.5 million deyiladi.

lessons.title: Agar ... bo'lsa: if va when
lessons.goal: Birinchi shart gapni o'zlashtirasiz va butun kitobning asosiy strukturalarini birgalikda mashq qilasiz.

frame.name: If / when + Present, ... will
frame.formula:
If it rains, I will stay at home.
If you need help, call me.
When I finish work, I'll go home.
If I were you, I'd ...
frame.explain: Birinchi shart gap: if + Present Simple, keyin will yoki buyruq. Muhim qoida: if va when dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi. Maslahat uchun esa If I were you, I'd ... strukturasidan foydalaning.
table: If you need help, call me.

aff: If it rains, I will stay at home.
When she comes, we will eat.
neg: If it doesn't rain, I won't stay at home.
When she doesn't come, we won't wait.
q: What will you do if it rains?
Will you call me when you arrive?

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a film.
examples.uz: Agar ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz va film ko'ramiz.

examples.en: If you need anything, just call me — I'm always ready to help.
examples.uz: Agar biror narsa kerak bo'lsa, menga qo'ng'iroq qiling — doim yordamga tayyorman.

examples.en: When I finish this project, I will take a long holiday.
examples.uz: Bu loyihani tugatganimda uzoq ta'tilga chiqaman.

examples.en: Maybe he will come, but I'm not sure — everything is possible.
examples.uz: Balki u keladi, lekin ishonchim komil emas — hamma narsa mumkin.

examples.en: Everyone has a different opinion, but we are working together on the same goal.
examples.uz: Har kimning fikri boshqacha, lekin biz bir maqsad uchun birga ishlaymiz.

examples.en: If something is impossible, try another way — there is always a solution.
examples.uz: Agar biror narsa imkonsiz bo'lsa, boshqa usulni sinab ko'ring — har doim yechim bor.

examples.en: Nobody knows the answer, so each of us will check one part.
examples.uz: Hech kim javobni bilmaydi, shuning uchun har birimiz bir qismini tekshiramiz.

examples.en: If I were you, I would ask someone else — you can't do everything alone.
examples.uz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, boshqa birovdan so'rardim — hamma narsani yolg'iz qila olmaysiz.

street.title: Kelishuv

items.en: If you want, we can meet later.

street.note: "Let me know" — "xabar bering", eng ko'p ishlatiladigan iboralardan biri; "Either way" — "qanday bo'lsa ham".

lines.en: Will you come to the meeting tomorrow?
Maybe. If my train arrives on time, I'll be there.
lines.uz: Balki. Agar poyezdim o'z vaqtida kelsa, bo'laman.

lines.en: When will you know?
I'll call you in the morning. If I don't call, it means I'm coming.
lines.uz: Ertalab qo'ng'iroq qilaman. Agar qo'ng'iroq qilmasam, kelaman degani.

lines.en: OK. And if nobody comes?
Then we'll do it online — everything is possible these days.
lines.uz: Unda onlayn qilamiz — hozir hamma narsa mumkin.

lessons.tip: Bu bilan 40 struktura tugadi. Endi eng muhim mashq: har bir struktura bilan o'zingiz haqingizda bitta gap tuzing. Misol: If I have time tomorrow, I'll read ten pages.
